role: Review-bounded math/symbol and Latin Extended-A fallback for the primary CJK font. Used only for codepoints the primary font cannot draw that fall inside the declared fallback_ranges; ordinary text always uses the primary font.

upstream.license: Bitstream Vera Fonts Copyright; Arev Fonts Copyright (Tavmjong Bah); DejaVu changes are public domain
upstream.modifications: none — the file is used unmodified, so the original family and PostScript name are kept (the license only requires renaming for modified copies)

coverage.verification: loaded with reportlab TTFont(..., validate=True) and re-read with fontTools getBestCmap before use; a missing required codepoint fails the gate instead of shipping.
